problems: Mobile menu keyboard order: the nav sits before the Menu button in the DOM, so forward Tab from an open menu leaves it, with the panel still open over the hero CTA.
About 11 mobile CSS overrides in the max-width:759px block never apply because later base rules of equal specificity override them, plus duplicated .ledger td rules and an orphaned .then-art rule.
Fonts shipped as six WOFF files (~175 KB) instead of WOFF2; og:image/twitter:image use a relative URL that social scrapers will not resolve.

reason: B puts an operable, labelled, internally consistent sample review in the first viewport at both widths, with a working accessible mobile menu, real buttons, a live region and zero errors. A is cleaner code but ships a static artifact and drops all navigation on phones and at 200% zoom. A finding that B's step switcher or menu broke under a real screen reader would change my mind; B's dead CSS and menu tab order are fixable maintenance debt, not breakage.
